scope_notes: Only the listed source classes are selected. Selected cranial nerves, arteries and veins retain their complete delivered extents, including any extracranial or cervical portions. These context classes are not restricted to the cranial cavity and have no invented side or segment subdivisions. Unselected tissues remain in the preserved original source.
The original source table contains 116 values, including its background value 50. Values not selected here map to output background 0.
No synthetic MRI, reflection, registration, smoothing, decimation or artificial subdivision is performed.

The complete current neurocranial scope contains 53 source classes, including the original ethmoidal and frontal sinus air classes alongside sphenoidal and mastoid air. Remaining source classes cover cervical spinal/vertebral, maxillofacial, eye, ear-specialist, muscle and other extra-intracranial tissues or source background; they remain in the original preserved model and source audit.
acquisition: Run neuroimage acquire mida_complete --data-root <existing-data-root>. Pinned extracted source members are verified and reused first. Otherwise a verified existing MIDA.zip is selectively expanded. If required inputs and the archive are absent, the command gives the official access page, expected size and exact destination; it does not submit an access request.

teaching_sequences.title: Deep anatomy and orientation
teaching_sequences.objective: Identify the delivered model classes and inspect their spatial relationships within the same native anatomy.
teaching_sequences.instruction: Use complete categorical sections before magnification. Change per-structure opacity or isolate a source label to expose context. The full source extent is preserved even where a vessel or nerve continues outside the cranial cavity.
teaching_sequences.evidence_limit: Unreviewed source model; original MRI is unavailable. Many values combine both sides. Whole vascular classes do not identify branches, general CSF does not segment named cisterns, and skull classes do not separately delineate foramina.
teaching_sequences.step_prompt: Locate this source-defined structure in the full available sections, then magnify at the same point and compare the 3D representation.
teaching_sequences.step_question: Which source structure or class is selected, and what does its representation not establish?
